close_reason: Added Participant.schedule_status: Option<Vec<String>> with skip_serializing_if; updated absent_when_none test; added schedule_status_roundtrip test; 57 tests pass; clippy clean
description: RFC 8984 §4.4.6 defines scheduleStatus: String[] (optional) on Participant — a list of ITIP status codes returned from the most recent scheduling message sent to this participant. This is server-set and persisted. The crate does not have this field; it is silently dropped on round-trip for events that have gone through server-side scheduling. Add: pub schedule_status: Option<Vec<String>> with skip_serializing_if. Also add a test.
title: Add Participant.scheduleStatus field (RFC 8984 §4.4.6)
